tool_selection.reasoning: For tabular data, SHAP provides robust, game-theoretic explanations that account for feature interactions and provide reliable feature importance rankings. LIME offers local interpretability via a simplified model, capturing context-specific influences. Integrated Gradients offer consistent, gradient-based attributions with improved stability. Sensitivity analysis provides causal insight by measuring the prediction change when each feature is ablated, offering grounded validation. Together, these tools complement autonomous reasoning by providing both quantitative and causal evidence of feature responsibility.
